need: Redesign the complete Learn AI Chat customer journey and interface as a course-wide learning assistant with durable continuity across the learner's course experience.
negativeBoundary: Do not merge this journey with academy-wide Global Chat, narrow it to a single lesson or challenge, persist raw transcripts, or implement before mandatory workflow approvals.
acceptanceCriteria: AI Chat remains inside Learn and carries relevant context across the complete course journey.
The journey explicitly separates Learn AI Chat ownership, entry points, context, and continuity from academy-wide Global Chat.
Learners can select or copy learning text and request an in-context translation or explanation.
Learners can request lesson explanations, challenge explanations, and broader study support without losing Learn continuity.
The design starts from current business authority and reaches each required approval gate before any product implementation begins.

accepts: AI assistant is scoped to Learn and remains available across the complete course journey.
Course-wide context and continuity persist across lessons, challenges, and study moments inside Learn.
Selected or copied learning text can be translated or explained in context.
Learners can ask for lesson and challenge explanations plus broader study support.
The mission starts from current business authority, preserves an explicit Global Chat boundary, and stops at mandatory approval gates before implementation.
rejects: Academy-wide Global Chat ownership, entry points, history, or behavior.
A chat experience constrained to only the current lesson or only the current challenge.
Implementation or product-source mutation before the workflow approval gates are satisfied.
Raw transcript persistence or silent expansion beyond the Learn course assistant journey.
